characteristic_organ_involvement: bone (symmetric osteosclerosis of long bones — diaphyseal/metaphyseal — characteristic and highly suggestive)
CNS (including brain parenchyma and hypothalamic-pituitary involvement; pontine/cerebellar lesions can occur)

biomarkers.name: BRAF V600E
biomarkers.clinical_use: Vemurafenib highly active — approved for BRAF V600 mutation-positive ECD. Cobimetinib approved for adults with histiocytic neoplasms (including ECD)

biomarkers.name: MAP2K1 (MEK1) mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: MEK inhibitors such as cobimetinib and trametinib can be active

biomarkers.name: NRAS, KRAS, ARAF, other MAPK pathway
biomarkers.clinical_use: MAPK pathway activation is very common in ECD; cobimetinib is approved for adults with histiocytic neoplasms

biomarkers.name: CD68+, CD163+, Factor XIIIa+; CD1a and langerin NEGATIVE (unlike LCH)
Symmetric osteosclerosis on bone scan / PET
biomarkers.clinical_use: Characteristic bilateral long-bone diaphyseal/metaphyseal osteosclerosis; PET-CT is useful for whole-body assessment

biomarkers.name: CT imaging findings (hairy kidney, coated aorta, pericardial thickening)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Multi-organ imaging pattern is highly suggestive in the appropriate clinicopathologic context

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Foamy CD68+/CD163+ histiocytes with abundant lipid-laden cytoplasm in fibrous stroma; extensive multi-organ infiltration; xanthomatous appearance
variants: mixed histiocytosis (ECD + LCH — overlap phenotype in some cases)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Not graded; systemic disease severity drives management

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: MAPK pathway activation is very common (BRAF V600E ~50-60%, other MAPK alterations in many of the remaining cases); vemurafenib is approved for BRAF V600-mutant ECD and cobimetinib is approved for adults with histiocytic neoplasms
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Foamy xanthomatous histiocytes in fibrous stroma; characteristic imaging includes symmetric long-bone osteosclerosis, 'hairy kidney' (perirenal infiltration), 'coated aorta' (periaortic sheathing), and pericardial thickening

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Monocyte-macrophage lineage (histiocytic/myeloid precursors) with MAPK pathway activation
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Foamy histiocytic (macrophage) differentiation (CD68+, CD163+, factor XIIIa+) with lipid-laden cytoplasm; CD1a-negative (distinguishes from LCH); non-Langerhans phenotype
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: MAPK pathway activation is very common — BRAF V600E (~50-60%), with other MAPK pathway mutations in many remaining cases; shares molecular biology with LCH, and mixed histiocytosis (ECD + LCH) reflects shared MAPK biology across related histiocytic lineages
